messages:
maya: Heads-up: customer success pushed a new enterprise ask today - legal hold + per-tenant retention toggle with audit trail. They want a launch checklist.

samira: Security checklist should include BYOK requirement options, immutable log writes, and key rotation documentation.

jonah: Eng note: we can surface a per-tenant retention toggle in the console that maps to retention tiers; export tooling will need to support on-demand snapshots.

celeste: CS: customer expects SOC2 evidence export within 3 business days. They mentioned terabyte-scale exports.

maya: Suggest we offer two guarantees: 72h for evidence indexes and metadata, N-day SLA for bulk exports with quoted ETA. Need to capture that in the customer-facing doc.

deploy-bot: @maya created doc "tenant-retention-launch-checklist.md" in #compliance-drive at 2026-04-12 09:00 UTC :white_check_mark:

maya: I'll draft the customer-facing proposal and loop legal/security for language.
